items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Brady called me from the union, and told me that it was all right if I wanted to go in and play Billy Berg's.

ctx.x: That was in San Diego, at some club down there that this lady was promoting. Anyway, what's that guy's name....Brady called me from the union, and told me that it was all right if I wanted to go in and play Billy Berg's. But then a couple of hours before, they'd told me I couldn't do it. So I seen who was running what, you know. I said, "Oh yeah, mmm-hmm."
Shove a couple of dollars in the right hand...
